text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, time management is essential. Make a schedule and set small goals for each day so you do not leave everything until the last minute. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important tasks first, especially when you have a lot to do. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish. If a task is too big, break it into smaller parts or agree with others on what is possible. Finally, communication is key. If you think you might miss a deadline, tell your team or manager early. They can often help, and it is always better than staying silent.
